title: Quantization matrix intake and SLA escrow for perf regression tracking
creator: Arielle Cheng
description: Create a structured intake and validation flow for quantization profiles (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) that ties each profile to a pinable model-version, publishes a standardized performance profile, and enrolls the artifact in an SLA-backed regression escrow. This ticket focuses on the intake contract, automated smoke checks, and the escrow mechanics that prevent accidental promotion of regressing artifacts.
proposed_solution: Add a 'quant-matrix' intake endpoint that collects profile metadata, deterministic fingerprint, and a minimal benchmark bundle. On intake, run lightweight smoke checks (latency p50/p95, basic accuracy deltas on golden prompts). If smoke checks pass, register the profile to a staging catalog with an escrow flag. Profiles marked for production promotion are gated by a canary job that compares perf deltas against the pinned model-version under the SLA basket. Integrate with the existing pin registry and add a forced-hold escrow state when regressions exceed thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Intake API accepts profiles for INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ and stores metadata + fingerprint
Automated smoke checks run within 10 minutes of intake and publish p50/p95, memory, and a small accuracy delta report
Profiles that trigger regression thresholds are tagged escrow and cannot be promoted without an explicit override and documented justification
Canary promotion job exists and runs against a configurable traffic slice; promotion emits an audit event and Slack notif to SRE and PM
Telemetry is available in Console: per-profile token cost delta, latency distribution, and quality regressions vs pinned baseline
implementation_steps: Design intake schema and minimal benchmark bundle (contrib: research + applied-ml)
Implement intake endpoint and storage (DB schema + signing metadata)
Build smoke-check runner (containerized workloads, default 50 prompt set)
Hook smoke checks to telemetry ingestion pipeline and Console dashboard
Integrate escrow states into pin registry and prevent auto-promotion
Create canary promotion orchestration and Slack/audit hooks
Add E2E tests and a nightly regression scanner for escrowed profiles
canary_plan: Start with a 1% traffic slice routed to the quantized profile for 24h. Monitor latency and accuracy signals every 15 min. If p95 latency increases >15% or accuracy delta >1.5% (model-dependent thresholds), automatically reduce traffic to 0 and mark profile escrowed. After a manual review, SRE/ML can either approve with mitigation notes or roll back pinning.
rollback_criteria: p95 latency increase >15% over pinned baseline
mean token cost growth >20% for sustained 1h
accuracy delta on golden prompts >1.5% (or project-specific threshold)
memory OOM observed in any canary replica
metrics_baseline: example_model:v2 pinned baseline: p50=42ms, p95=120ms, cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.24
